articles.title: Deutsche Bank sees Eutelsat debt risk rising on costly satellite renewal
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Deutsche Bank cut its rating on satellite operator Eutelsat Communications (EPA:ETL) to "sell" from "hold" and lowered its price target to €1.30 from €2.10, citing the high cost of funding its next-generation satellite network and the risk of rising debt becoming an issue.

articles.title: Barclays downgrades European forklift makers as Chinese imports jump 51% in Q3
articles.summary: Investing.com -- Barclays downgraded industrial truck makers Kion and Jungheinrich to “equal weight” from “overweight” on Thursday, saying imports of Chinese forklifts into the European Union rose 51% in the third quarter from a year earlier.

articles.title: Berenberg upgrades Bayer to buy as litigation risks ease, pharma outlook improves
